name: Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. In case of the death of a registered worker, an amount of ₹15,000/- is payable as funeral assistance to his/her nominee/legal heirs.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased worker.
   1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The registered deceased worker should have held a regular membership with the Board.
   1. The scheme allows for application only once.
